# ui::DoubleAnimation

Header: `winui/ui/Animation.hpp`.

A from/to/by animation of one property. A missing `from` starts from the property's current animated value. `to` wins over `by`, and with neither the animation goes back to the property's own value. `duration` is one iteration, a second by default. `repeat_count` is the number of iterations, infinity repeats forever, and an auto-reversing iteration lasts two durations. On a three-component property (Translation, Scale, CenterPoint), every component runs the same values.

Example: 
```cpp
auto                  stack = std::make_unique<ui::StackControl>(ui::Orientation::Vertical);
ui::RectangleControl* rect  = stack->add(std::make_unique<ui::RectangleControl>());
rect->start_animation(ui::AnimatedProperty::TranslationX,
                      ui::DoubleAnimation{.to           = 200.0f,
                                          .duration     = 500ms,
                                          .easing       = ui::CircleEase{ui::EasingMode::EaseInOut},
                                          .on_completed = [] { /* now at x + 200 */ }});

// A pulsing fade that gives the property back when done.
rect->start_animation(ui::AnimatedProperty::Opacity,
                      ui::DoubleAnimation{.from         = 1.0f,
                                          .to           = 0.2f,
                                          .duration     = 300ms,
                                          .auto_reverse = true,
                                          .repeat_count = 3.0,
                                          .fill         = ui::FillBehavior::Stop});
```

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `from` | `OptionalFloat` |  | Start value. Unset starts from the property's current animated value. |
| `to` | `OptionalFloat` |  | End value; wins over `by`. |
| `by` | `OptionalFloat` |  | End value relative to the start, used when `to` is unset. |
| `duration` | `Duration` | `{1000.0}` | Length of one iteration. |
| `easing` | `std::optional<EasingFunction>` |  | Curve over each iteration. Unset is linear. |
| `begin_time` | `Duration` |  | Delay before the first iteration. |
| `auto_reverse` | `bool` | `false` | Plays each iteration forward then backward, doubling its length. |
| `repeat_count` | `double` | `1.0` | Iterations to run; `std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity()` repeats forever. |
| `fill` | `FillBehavior` | `FillBehavior::HoldEnd` | What the property shows once the animation finishes. |
| `on_completed` | `Callback<void()>` |  | Fires once when the animation finishes (not when it is replaced or stopped). |
